Hi Timothy — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Recap:
- Discovery highlights: primary workload will be patient-facing inference for triage (PII: hashed IDs only), peak concurrent sessions ~120, expected median seq length 512 tokens.
- Requirement: private VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC peering/VPN), SOC2 evidence & audit log retention (1 year).
- Ops constraint: contact window for maintenance is M-F 0200–0600 PT.

Requested next step: Technical architecture review (private/VPC on-prem options) with our infra leads to align network, IAM, and perf expectations. Proposed attendees: your infra lead + security contact, our Dedicated/Private engineering + solutions architect (Cc’d: Marissa, Monica).

Proposed 90‑minute windows (PT):
- Wed 16 Jun — 09:00–10:30
- Wed 16 Jun — 13:30–15:00
- Thu 17 Jun — 08:00–09:30

Draft agenda (30/60/90):
- 0–15: quick recap of discovery & success criteria
- 15–45: network & identity (VPC, peering, egress, KMS/HSM options)
- 45–70: runtime/ops (autoscaling, maintenance windows, observability)
- 70–90: open Q/A & next steps (PoC scope, timeline, security artifacts)

I’ve attached a short pre-call checklist and my notes from the discovery. Can you confirm which window works and who from your side we should invite (security contact + network engineer)? If helpful, we can provide a trimmed 45‑minute version focused on the network and ops sections only.

Thanks — Ben
